footer.security: You get this message because it concerns the security of your North admin account; it cannot be turned off.
footer.jobs: Job emails can be turned off on the account page: {account_url}

test.subject: North: test email
test.body:
Hello {username},

This is a test message from the North admin. If you can read it, email works.

Sent at {at}.

verify_email.subject: North: confirm your email address
verify_email.body:
Hello {username},

Open this link to confirm that this address belongs to your North admin account:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. Until you confirm, password reset and notifications do not use this address.

If you did not expect this message, ignore it.

password_reset.subject: North: reset your password
password_reset.body:
Hello {username},

Someone (from address {ip}) asked to reset the password of your North admin account. To choose a new password, open:

{url}

The link works once and expires in {minutes} minutes. Your authenticator code is still required at sign-in.

If it was not you, ignore this message: your password has not changed.

password_changed.subject: North: your password was changed
password_changed.body:
Hello {username},

The password of your North admin account was changed at {at} (address {ip}). Every other session was signed out.

If it was not you, reset your password at {admin_url}/forgot and tell the other admins.

totp_changed.subject: North: your authenticator app was changed
totp_changed.body:
Hello {username},

A new authenticator app was set up for your North admin account at {at} (address {ip}). Codes from the previous app no longer work.

If it was not you, tell the other admins at once.

email_changed.subject: North: your account email was changed
email_changed.body:
Hello {username},

The email address of your North admin account was changed at {at} to {new_email}. This address will no longer receive password reset links.

If it was not you, tell the other admins at once.

new_sign_in.subject: North: new sign-in to your account

login_locked.subject: North: sign-in paused after failed attempts
login_locked.body:
Hello {username},

There were {failures} failed sign-in attempts on your North admin account (last from address {ip}). Sign-in for this account is paused for {minutes} minutes.

If it was not you, your password is still safe as long as nobody knows it; consider changing it to a longer one.

access_changed.subject: North: your account was changed by an admin
access_changed.body:
Hello {username},

The admin {admin} changed your North admin account at {at}:

{changes}

Your sessions were signed out.

changes.password_reset: temporary password set (you choose a new one at the next sign-in)
changes.totp_reset: authenticator app removed (you set up a new one at the next sign-in)
